So, my dear student, embrace the beauty of dissonance in your compositions, but remember to balance it with moments of resolution to create a journey that resonates with the listener's heart and soul. He was able to push the boundaries of traditional forms and structures precisely because he understood them so deeply. While it is important to study and understand these rules, it is equally important to know when and how to bend or break them to achieve artistic innovation.

So, my dear student, do not view rules as cages for your music, but rather as pillars that support and elevate your creativity.
